en.label: Liyan cups the flame
en.hint: The fire does not need to roar yet. Voilà.

en.label: My sword tip taps the ground
en.hint: It will still be warm when you come back. Allez.

en.label: Hat pulled down low
en.hint: One sound and I am awake. Bonjour to that.

en.label: Liyan runs in with news
en.hint: I will not disturb you; one sentence, that is all. Voilà.

bubble.label: 火苗跳了一下
bubble.hint: 我把它记在小本子上了

en.label: The flame jumps once
en.hint: Written in my little notebook, of course. Voilà.

en.label: My sword hilt flashes
en.hint: The numbers have not turned sour. Good.

en.label: My hat tassel sways
en.hint: You get on with your real work. Allez.

bubble.label: 栗焰举起法棍
bubble.hint: 法棍和长剑，就是我的轻量极速。法国籍的独角兽，不接受反驳。

en.label: Liyan raises the baguette
en.hint: Baguette plus sword: my light-footed speed. Non, do not argue.

en.label: Several checks in a row
en.hint: The flame never even flickered. Voilà.

en.label: The flame burns brighter
en.hint: A fine moment for getting things done. Allez.

en.label: Warm light on the bread-blade
en.hint: I am keeping count, do not worry. Voilà.

en.label: You touched my tassel
en.hint: My hat nearly fell off. Watch those hands, non?

en.label: Poked, was I?
en.hint: My bread-blade almost dropped. Allez, gently.
